visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male athlete with dark hair and glasses, wearing a black, white, and gold Flash Wolves team jersey with a prominent Red Bull logo, stands before a large window. The background is a bright, high-key cityscape of skyscrapers. He looks directly at the camera, speaking and occasionally adjusting his spectacles with a neutral to focused facial expression. Large white text captions are overlaid on the center of the screen. (2) The scene cuts to a screen recording of the mobile game Arena of Valor. Various stylized fantasy characters are engaged in a high-intensity battle against a large purple-glowing boss monster in a circular arena. Bright visual effects like purple circles, gold streaks, and digital icons represent abilities being used. Health bars and game UI elements are visible at the top and bottom edges. (3) The visual returns to the man in the jersey standing by the window. He continues his explanation, maintaining steady eye contact with the lens and small micro-movements of his head as he speaks. The lighting remains bright and natural from the outdoor scene. (4) The scene shifts to a different indoor setting where the same man is seated at a dark desk. He appears physically drained, leaning forward and looking down towards the surface. He rubs his eyes and forehead with his hand, showing clear signs of exhaustion and fatigue. The background is an indoor room with muted lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 奶綠現在打贏FS. [Logo]: APL 2025 · 賽後快訪. (2) [Subtitle]: 進入了線下賽 你的心情怎麼樣. (3) [Subtitle]: 當然就還蠻開心. (4) [Subtitle]: 但是今天打的內容. (5) [Subtitle]: 其實還可以再調整得更好. (6) [Subtitle]: 打FS最後一把 當時33分的時候 綁到菫. (7) [Subtitle]: 你可以說一下那波的溝通是怎樣嗎. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為那波他們一定會吃凱. (9) [Subtitle]: 吃凱我們一定也守不住. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以那邊唯一的逆轉就是. (11) [Subtitle]: 把射手給殺了. (12) [Subtitle]: 讓他們野凱前排 衝我們後排. (13) [Subtitle]: 我把他後排沖了. (14) [Subtitle]: 讓綺蘿有個搶凱撒的機會. (15) [Subtitle]: 不然被吃掉 基本上就輸了. (16) [Subtitle]: 線下賽 我們會努力調整好狀態. (17) [Subtitle]: 復刻我們的2020 APL成功. (18) [Subtitle]: 今天狀態還好嗎. (19) [Subtitle]: 你今天看起來身體不太舒服. (20) [Subtitle]: 也沒有怎樣 就有點累了. (21) [Subtitle]: 最後一把 打到腳都軟了.
